<!--
TextDuet welcomes focused changes that preserve the privacy, permission, cost, and MV3 runtime boundaries.
TextDuet 欢迎保持隐私、权限、费用和 MV3 运行时边界的单一目的改动。

Never paste API keys, authentication headers, private URLs, account data, page contents, or sensitive screenshots here.
请勿在 PR 中粘贴 API Key、认证头、私密 URL、账户数据、网页正文或敏感截图。
-->

# Pull request / 拉取请求

## Summary / 摘要

<!-- What user problem does this change solve? / 这个改动解决什么用户问题？ -->

## Related issue / 关联 Issue

<!-- Use `Fixes #123` or explain why no issue is linked. / 使用 `Fixes #123`，或说明为何没有关联 Issue。 -->

## Change scope / 改动范围

- [ ] This PR has one primary purpose and avoids unrelated refactors. / 本 PR 只有一个主要目的，未夹带无关重构。
- [ ] User-visible behavior is described in the PR summary. / PR 摘要已说明用户可见行为。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build` (when source or build configuration changed) / 源码或构建配置变化时已运行
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] I manually checked relevant failure, stop, empty, and narrow-screen states when applicable. / 适用时已检查相关失败、停止、空状态和窄屏状态。

Test notes and known gaps / 测试说明与已知缺口：

## Screenshots or recordings / 截图或录屏

<!-- Required for UI changes. Use only public or synthetic pages; redact all private data. / UI 改动必须提供。仅使用公开或合成页面，并遮盖所有私密数据。 -->

## Documentation / 文档

- [ ] English user or contributor documentation is updated when needed. / 需要时已更新英文用户或贡献者文档。
- [ ] Chinese user or contributor documentation is updated when needed. / 需要时已更新中文用户或贡献者文档。
- [ ] No release or privacy claim is marked as completed without evidence. / 没有在缺少证据时宣称发布或隐私事项完成。

## Privacy, permissions, and cost impact / 隐私、权限与费用影响

- [ ] No new user data, permission, provider, network, or storage behavior. / 未新增用户数据、权限、Provider、网络或存储行为。
- [ ] If behavior changed, the PR explains purpose, scope, lifecycle, access, clearing, and user consent. / 如有变化，PR 已说明目的、范围、生命周期、访问者、清除方式和用户同意。
- [ ] No API key or decrypted vault value crosses into page content, logs, screenshots, or issue/PR text. / API Key 或保险箱解密值未进入网页内容、日志、截图或 Issue/PR 文本。
- [ ] Any provider cost or budget impact is documented and uses estimates where appropriate. / Provider 费用或预算影响已记录，适用时明确为预估。

## Compatibility and breaking changes / 兼容性与破坏性变更

- [ ] Chrome MV3 behavior and documented permissions remain within the project contract. / Chrome MV3 行为和文档权限仍符合项目契约。
- [ ] Breaking changes, migrations, or data-clearing behavior are explicitly described. / 已明确说明破坏性变化、迁移或数据清除行为。
- [ ] This PR does not add remote executable code, telemetry, advertising, or a proxy service. / 本 PR 未新增远程可执行代码、遥测、广告或中转服务。

## License / 许可证

- [ ] I confirm that I have the right to submit this work and that my contribution is provided under Apache-2.0. No DCO or CLA is required. / 我确认有权提交本改动，并按 Apache-2.0 提供贡献；项目不要求 DCO 或 CLA。
